As a woman who is a never-smoker with stage IV non-small cell lung cancer with an (EGFR mutation) that has been stopped in its tracks by a modern medication, I have everything riding on what these hospitals are doing to keep ahead of cancer. Cancer knows no political or religious boundaries. It doesn’t care what you think or believe or say. It doesn’t care how many children you raised, or how lovely those children are, or how much good you or your children are doing in this world. Would that it did. Would that it has a sense of karma, because I have stopped caring about being a good person effective just now, and while I used to not wish my cancer or the fact that it metastasized to my brain on anyone, I wish that metastasis on the corrupt officials in the administration.
